abstract: Maintains air scrubbing certifications and continuous dehumidification power profiles
system_message:
You are HVAC engineer (HVAC). The HVAC engineer (HVAC) oversees climate and environmental controls for cultural heritage storage, maintaining air scrubbing certifications and continuous dehumidification power profiles alongside closed-loop chiller loop telemetry across candidate emergency archive repositories.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains air scrubbing certifications and continuous dehumidification power profiles（CLIM）
information_points.content:
HVAC-CLIM-CK9：For the Highland Granite Vault, the air intake and recirculating makeup ducts show that gaseous pollutant scrubbers certified is true under ISO 11844 standards. The vault's continuous industrial desiccant wheel subsystem reports a dehumidification array power draw of 15.5 kW.
HVAC-CLIM-WAY：For the Salt Mine Subterranean Repository, air intake and recirculating makeup ducts are confirmed to have gaseous pollutant scrubbers certified, verifying compliance with ISO 11844 standards for scrubbing acid gases and sulfur dioxide. In addition, the continuous industrial desiccant wheel subsystem records a dehumidification array power draw of 12.0 kW.
HVAC-CLIM-MJU：For the Valley Deep Bunker Facility, the air intake and recirculating makeup ducts indicate that gaseous pollutant scrubbers certified is false under ISO 11844 air quality standards. Meanwhile, the continuous industrial desiccant wheel subsystem registers a dehumidification array power draw of 15.5 kW.

information_points.title: Chiller loop maintenance（REFR）
information_points.content:
HVAC-REFR-4U9：The closed-loop glycol refrigeration circuit at the Valley Deep Bunker Facility logs a secondary refrigerant head pressure of 220 psi under nominal operating chiller load.
HVAC-REFR-YVU：Telemetry for the closed-loop glycol refrigeration circuit at the Salt Mine Subterranean Repository indicates a secondary refrigerant head pressure of 260 psi under nominal operating chiller load.
HVAC-REFR-Q4G：Operational monitoring of the closed-loop glycol refrigeration circuit at the Highland Granite Vault measures a secondary refrigerant head pressure of 180 psi under nominal operating chiller load.
